name: FREE - AI Movie Recommendations to Telegram

values.content:
=You are a movie recommendation editor for a Telegram channel.

Create a concise and engaging Telegram movie recommendation based only on the movie data below.

Movie title:
{{ $json.title }}

Original title:
{{ $json.original_title }}

Overview:
{{ $json.overview }}

Release date:
{{ $json.release_date }}

TMDB rating:
{{ $json.vote_average }}

TMDB vote count:
{{ $json.vote_count }}

Requirements:
- Write in English.
- Start with the movie title and one relevant emoji.
- Write 2 short sentences describing why the movie may be worth watching.
- Do not invent facts that are not provided.
- Do not include spoilers.
- Include the release year.
- Include the TMDB rating rounded to one decimal place.
- End with exactly 3 relevant hashtags.
- Keep the entire text under 700 characters.
- Do not use Markdown formatting.
- Return only the final Telegram post text with no explanations.

parameters.content:
START HERE

This workflow automatically discovers high-quality movies from TMDB, ranks the candidates, avoids previously published movies, generates an AI-written recommendation, validates the result, and publishes the movie poster with the caption to Telegram.

SETUP

1. Open "Workflow Settings"
2. Configure your movie selection preferences:
   - minimum rating
   - minimum vote count
   - release date
   - excluded genres
   - excluded countries
   - TMDB language
   - maximum random page
   - publication history limit
3. Open "Fetch Movies from TMDB"
4. Replace YOUR_TMDB_API_KEY with your TMDB API key
5. Connect your OpenAI credential in "Generate Telegram Recommendation"
6. Connect your Telegram Bot credential in "Send a photo message"
7. Replace @your_channel_username with your Telegram channel username
8. Add the Telegram bot as an administrator of the channel

HOW IT WORKS

- fetches movie candidates from TMDB using configurable filters
- removes movies with missing posters, descriptions, ratings, or release dates
- calculates a quality score using rating, vote count, and popularity
- ranks candidates from best to worst
- skips movies stored in the publication history
- selects the highest-scoring unpublished movie
- generates a Telegram recommendation with OpenAI
- validates the AI response before publishing
- prepares the TMDB poster and caption
- publishes the post to Telegram
- remembers the successfully published movie to prevent future duplicates

QUALITY CONTROL

The workflow stops with a clear error if:
- no valid movie candidates are available
- all current candidates were already published
- OpenAI returns an empty or invalid recommendation
- the recommendation does not contain exactly 3 hashtags

The publication history is updated only after the Telegram message is successfully sent.

TELEGRAM SETUP

Before running this node:

- connect your own Telegram Bot credential
- replace @your_channel_username with your channel username
- add the bot as an administrator of the channel
- test with a private/test channel first
